turn: The withdrawal-events export is now scheduled to run daily at 02:00, ahead of the biobank shipping run. In src/export_withdrawals/schedule.py I added a FEED_CRON constant set to "0 2 * * *". I also added a register function that adds the job to the scheduler as a cron trigger with hour=2 and minute=0. I checked that the constant and the scheduler arguments describe the same time. I did not run the scheduler or wait for a real 02:00 trigger, so the first live run is still unobserved. In the same commit I fixed a small unrelated problem I came across: the export module's date helper built timestamps without a timezone, so I made it use UTC explicitly. Next I'll start on "Export of audit trail".

sidefix.title: Use explicit UTC in date helper
sidefix.what: The export module's date helper created naive timestamps, so it now builds them with UTC explicitly.
